name: CAROL sell callback manipulates liquidity-rebalancing reserves
summary: sell pays ETH through an external router before computing the LP burn from current ethReserved. The seller callback reduces that reserve with CAROL-to-WETH trades, causing the subsequent burn to consume nearly all protocol LP; flash-loan spot manipulation also inflates bond-token credit.
notes: Gross depletion of the CAROL/WETH pool reserves, excluding the preparatory attacker liquidity contribution. LP burning is supporting custody evidence; it is not added to loss again.
